# Phase 2 — Desktop editor

## Goal

Create the visual editor and job workflow interface in a modern, productive ergonomic style.

## Deliverables

- Main window with a polished layout
- Component palette
- Graph editing surface
- Property panel
- Save/load flows

## Acceptance criteria

- Users can build a job visually.
- Component links are validated.
- Jobs can be executed from the interface.
- The UI remains decoupled from engine internals.
